final: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), proportions AS (SELECT rating, film_count, film_count * 1.0 / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS proportion FROM per_rating), mean_proportion AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) AS avg_proportion FROM proportions), kept AS (SELECT p.film_count, p.proportion, p.proportion - m.avg_proportion AS difference FROM proportions p CROSS JOIN mean_proportion m WHERE p.proportion > m.avg_proportion) SELECT SUM(film_count), AVG(proportion), AVG(difference) FROM kept
